headline: Dead Lands Erupt as Mooring County Flares Anew
war_summary: Since the last edition the guns have found a fresh thunderclap: the Dead Lands, quiet on flags, now post the war's steepest surge, Warden losses running near a thousand the hour against some three hundred Colonial, both climbing fast, though its eleven posts stay in Colonial hands. Mooring County, briefly stilled, has flared anew, flags turning at The Wind Hills as late as half past ten and casualties mounting from a trickle. In the Weathered Expanse the five-Colonial, four-Warden tally holds while Frostmarch logged twenty-six events in the day, the latest before eleven o'clock, and combined losses there top two thousand men the hour. The Linn of Mercy has raised no flag since evening at Lathair, yet its toll accelerates, Wardens now bleeding faster than Colonials. Stlican Shelf's five-Warden, four-Colonial count stands, quiet since Thornhold's evening flurry but still bleeding hard. Fishermans Row, wholly Colonial after its night of flux, has not turned a flag since before seven, and Callahans Passage's great storm has ebbed to a mutter, though Nevish Line remains bloody without flag movement. Day 296 of the war; no victor declared, thirty-four victory towns required.
